summary: Round 2: every round-1 issue closed. The BLOCKER (bare score → empty reply) is fully fixed and the new stashed-score UX is a clear win: type '2-1' cold, tap a match, score applies to all 3 pencas in one round trip with zero retyping. Auto-routing (killer feature) did NOT regress — verified across three score-writes (Bolívar/Flamengo/River) to all 3 pencas with stable 'Anotado en *X*, *Y*, *Z*' formatting. Listar pencas now shows '· N jugadores · M pronósticos' per row. Home text uses 'mis pencas' (not 'mis grupos'). Cold welcome no longer mentions 'mundialistas'. New paper-cuts found: 'jugadores' pluralization is wrong for solo pencas ('1 jugadores'), and the stashed-score prefix still says 'Tocá uno y lo anoto' even when the user has every match predicted and there is no list to tap.

findings.where: bare score with NO pending-match (round-1 BLOCKER fix)
findings.what: Round-1 BLOCKER closed. Sending '2-1' as the first message after creating 3 pencas now replies 'Recibí *2-1* pero no sé para qué partido. Tocá uno y lo anoto.' + an Interactive List of pending matches grouped by competition. No more silent fall-through to the empty LLM reply.
findings.evidence:
After creating Los del 92 / Penca del Barrio / Pibes del 5 and sending '2-1' cold, reply = 'Recibí *2-1* pero no sé para qué partido. Tocá uno y lo anoto.

Te faltan *2* pronósticos:

*🥇 Libertadores 2026* — 2 partidos

_Tocá uno y te pido el marcador._' + list rows [{Flamengo vs Palmeiras}, {River vs Boca}]. Code path: class-mantia-whatsapp-flow.php:207-211 (stashes the score, prefixes handle_pending output).

findings.what: Type '2-1' cold (no match context). Bot stashes 2-1 in a 5-min transient and shows pending matches. Tap mantia:match:6390 (Flamengo vs Palmeiras). Bot auto-applies the stashed 2-1 across all 3 pencas in a single round trip — no need to retype. Real UX win: turns the failure case into a feature.
findings.evidence: After 'Recibí *2-1* pero no sé...' prefix, sending mantia:match:6390 returned '✅ Anotado en *Los del 92*, *Penca del Barrio*, *Pibes del 5*: Flamengo 2 - 1 Palmeiras'. Re-tested with '1-0' + tap mantia:match:6382 → '✅ Anotado en ... : Bolívar 1 - 0 Cerro Porteño'. Code path: class-mantia-whatsapp-flow.php:1837-1843 reads the stash on match-tap and calls handle_quick_score directly.

findings.what: Did NOT regress. After tapping mantia:match:6391 (River vs Boca) the bot prompted for a score; '3-2' wrote to all 3 pencas. Reply 'Anotado en *Los del 92*, *Penca del Barrio*, *Pibes del 5*: River Plate 3 - 2 Boca Juniors'. DB shows 3 separate prediction posts (pids 6869/6870/6871) — one per group, all with River 3-2 Boca, all linked to user 6764. Overwrite (1-0 applied later via stashed flow) updated the same row set in-place.
findings.evidence: state.predictions = 30 after all writes; per-group breakdown shows match_id 6391 mapped to group_ids 6763/6773/6792 (the 3 pencas). Reply order matches creation order. Asterisk wrapping intact.

findings.what: Round-1 paper-cut closed. Each row now shows torneo + member + prediction counts: '📆 Libertadores semanal · 1 jugadores · 9 pronósticos'. Diego can see at a glance where he has predictions pending.
findings.evidence: Row for Los del 92: {title:'Los del 92', description:'📆 Libertadores semanal · 1 jugadores · 9 pronósticos'}. Source: class-mantia-whatsapp-flow.php:1176 builds the line via _n( '%d jugador · %d pronóstico', '%d jugadores · %d pronósticos', max(...) ).

findings.what: Round-1 paper-cut closed. Home now says 'Tenés 3 pencas en total. Escribí *mis pencas* para verlas.' — matches the product noun everywhere else. The lingering 'mis grupos' suggestion is gone.
findings.evidence: Reply to 'home': 'Activa: *Pibes del 5*\n📆 Libertadores semanal • codigo `PIBESDEL5JRJMG`\nTenés 3 pencas en total. Escribí *mis pencas* para verlas.' Code: class-mantia-whatsapp-flow.php:1347.

findings.what: Round-1 paper-cut closed. Welcome text now says 'la app de pronósticos de fútbol por WhatsApp' instead of 'mundialistas'. Correct for the Libertadores-only seed.
findings.evidence: Reply to 'hola' (cold user): 'Hola. Soy *Mantia*, la app de pronósticos de fútbol por WhatsApp.\n\n¿Por dónde arrancamos?' Code: class-mantia-whatsapp-flow.php:1299.

findings.what: Three pencas created in sequence with no throttling on the create path. Each created with its own group_id (6763/6773/6792), correctly tagged competition=libertadores-semana, and auto-populated with 8 default predictions per penca (24 total at the start). Rate-limit DOES fire later — but only on score writes (see polish note).
findings.evidence: state.groups = 3 distinct ids; state.predictions = 24 before any user score writes; no rate-limit message during the 3 sequential creates.

findings.what: Picker still has EXACTLY 2 rows (Libertadores 2026 + Libertadores semanal) and the IDs are the documented mantia:competition:<slug> shape — confirmed across all 3 creates.
findings.evidence: Picker rows on each of the 3 create flows: [{id:'mantia:competition:libertadores-2026', title:'🥇 Libertadores 2026'}, {id:'mantia:competition:libertadores-semana', title:'📆 Libertadores semanal'}].

findings.what: Diego's 3 pencas are tagged libertadores-semana but the seed matches are tagged libertadores-2026. Mantia_Repository::user_groups_in_competition() correctly normalizes both to the same storage_id, so auto-routing across the 'semanal' vs 'full tournament' framings Just Works. No user-visible 'wrong torneo' error even though the slugs differ.
findings.evidence: Match 6390 (Flamengo vs Palmeiras) has _mantia_competition_id='libertadores-2026'. Groups 6763/6773/6792 have _mantia_competition_id='libertadores-semana'. handle_quick_score still wrote to all 3 (verified via state query showing 3 prediction posts for match_id=6390). Code: class-mantia-repository.php:497-508.

findings.what: Description says '1 jugadores' for a solo penca — should be '1 jugador'. Code uses _n with max(member_count, pred_count) as the pluralization decider, so when there are 9 pronósticos (plural) but 1 jugador (singular) it picks the plural form for BOTH halves, producing '1 jugadores · 9 pronósticos'. Wrong for the player half.
findings.fix_hint: Split the line into two _n calls — one for jugadores using $member_count, one for pronósticos using $pred_count — and concatenate, instead of one combined format string controlled by max().
findings.evidence: All 3 rows show '… · 1 jugadores · 9 pronósticos'. Source: class-mantia-whatsapp-flow.php:1176 — single sprintf+_n with max() as the count.

findings.where: bare-score prefix when user has nothing pending
findings.what: Send '1-0' cold when every match is already predicted: bot replies 'Recibí *1-0* pero no sé para qué partido. Tocá uno y lo anoto.\n\n✅ Tenés todos los partidos pronosticados. ¡Bien ahí!' — prefix tells user to 'Tocá uno' but the body says there's nothing to tap, and there is no Interactive List. Contradictory copy. The score is also stashed for 5 min and will silently overwrite the next match the user taps, which can be surprising.
findings.fix_hint: In class-mantia-whatsapp-flow.php:207-211, when handle_pending() returns the 'todos los partidos pronosticados' branch, either (a) skip stashing and reply 'Recibí *X-Y* pero ya tenés todos los partidos pronosticados. Tocá un partido para cambiar el marcador.' with a 'Partidos' button, or (b) keep the stash but change the prefix to 'Recibí *X-Y*. Tocá un partido en *Partidos* para anotarlo.'
findings.evidence: Send '1-0' (no pending match) → reply contains both 'Tocá uno y lo anoto.' AND 'Tenés todos los partidos pronosticados.' with interactive.type='button' (NO list). The 1-0 stash then silently applied when tapping match 6382 in the next turn (overwriting 3-2 with 1-0).

findings.where: rate-limiter trips on the legitimate organizer pattern
findings.what: Sending 'tap match → score' twice in <30s triggers 'Estás mandando muchos mensajes en poco tiempo. Esperá ~60s y volvé a intentar.' The organizer-of-3-pencas persona (Diego's whole brief) is also the user most likely to fire several score writes in a row. The throttle hits a legitimate use case — and worse, the throttle message blocks even a 'mis pencas' query, not just score writes.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) raise the per-minute cap from whatever it is now (looks like ~2-3/min) to ~8-10 for authenticated users with ≥1 penca, or (b) only throttle write operations (create-penca, score) and let read-only commands (mis pencas, partidos, home, leaderboard) through.
findings.evidence: Sequence: tap mantia:match:6391 → reply OK in 47ms; immediately send '3-2' → reply 'Estás mandando muchos mensajes en poco tiempo. Esperá ~60s y volvé a intentar.' in 11ms. After 70s cooldown, same '3-2' wrote successfully. Subsequent 'mis pencas' (read-only) was ALSO blocked during the cooldown window.

findings.what: Still the round-1 visual mismatch: body uses '✅ *Pibes del 5*' but the row title uses '✓ Pibes del 5' (different checkmark glyph), and inactive ones use '▫️' in body but no prefix in row. Three different visual treatments for the same active/inactive status.
findings.evidence: Reply text contains '▫️ *Los del 92*' / '▫️ *Penca del Barrio*' / '✅ *Pibes del 5*'. Row titles: 'Los del 92' / 'Penca del Barrio' / '✓ Pibes del 5'.
